Title: Routes Component
Summary: Blazor Router configuration defining the routing behavior and not-found fallback.
Content:
## Routes.razor

**Path:** `Components/Routes.razor`

**Type:** Root routing component (no `@page` directive)

### Purpose

Configures the Blazor `Router` with the application's assembly, default layout, and not-found page behavior.

### Markup

```razor
<Router AppAssembly="typeof(Program).Assembly" NotFoundPage="typeof(Pages.NotFound)">
    <Found Context="routeData">
        <RouteView RouteData="routeData" DefaultLayout="typeof(Layout.MainLayout)" />
        <FocusOnNavigate RouteData="routeData" Selector="h1" />
    </Found>
</Router>
```

### Configuration

| Attribute | Value | Description |
|-----------|-------|-------------|
| `AppAssembly` | `typeof(Program).Assembly` | Scans the entry assembly for routable components (`@page` directives). |
| `NotFoundPage` | `typeof(Pages.NotFound)` | Renders `NotFound.razor` when no route matches. |
| `DefaultLayout` | `typeof(Layout.MainLayout)` | Wraps all matched routes in `MainLayout.razor`. |

### FocusOnNavigate

Automatically sets focus to the first `<h1>` element after navigation. This improves accessibility for screen reader users by announcing the new page content.

### Notes

- This component is rendered inside `App.razor` with `InteractiveServer` render mode.
- The `NotFoundPage` is used for client-side 404s; server-side 404s are handled by `UseStatusCodePagesWithReExecute("/not-found")` in `Program.cs`.
